belirleyici_veriler.aciklama: This is the principal favorable valuation indicator, but its numerator is a parent-attribution proxy rather than a reported parent cash-flow measure.
Current YTD free cash flow fell to 481.0 million USD from 1,105.0 million USD, weakening the durability of the apparently favorable cash-flow yield.
The report provides no prospective earnings or cash-flow evidence capable of supporting the premium historical multiples.

tezi_bozacak_kosullar: A future filing demonstrates durable acceleration in revenue, operating profit, and net profit sufficient to support the current valuation multiples.
Operating cash flow and free cash flow recover from their current YTD levels while cash conversion remains sound.
A valuation reset or a substantial increase in reconciled TTM earnings and operating income materially reduces the current multiples.
belirsizlik: Forward estimates are absent, preventing assessment of whether future growth can justify the valuation premium.
Gross profit and gross margin are unavailable, limiting analysis of core merchandising economics.
Issuer-reported EBITDA and issuer-reported net debt are unavailable.
No structured debt or lease maturity schedules were extracted, limiting the long-horizon refinancing assessment.
Maintenance and growth capital expenditures are not separated.
The market price is 72 days later than the latest financial cut-off, with no post-period financial adjustment.
gerekce: KR is profitable and cash-generative, and the 7.86% parent-attributed TTM free-cash-flow yield offers some valuation support. That support is insufficient because it relies on a proxy while current YTD free cash flow declined 56.5% and operating cash flow declined 17.4%. Against modest revenue, operating-profit, and net-profit growth, the 33.98x P/E and 24.45x lease-exclusive EV/reported operating-income multiples require prospective improvement that the report does not evidence. The standalone disqualifier is therefore unsupported valuation rather than immediate financial fragility.
